moments.title: The Hundred Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is in full swing, with matches continuing this week across the UK, including Sunrisers Leeds vs Manchester Super Giants today.

angles.name: Today's Match
angles.copy: It's match day in The Hundred! Sunrisers Leeds take on Manchester Super Giants at Headingley today. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Midweek Cricket
angles.copy: The Hundred action continues this week! Welsh Fire, Trent Rockets, MI London, and London Spirit all have matches coming up. Catch the fast-paced cricket.

moments.title: Premier League Season Nears
moments.blurb: Anticipation is building for the 2026/27 Premier League season, which kicks off on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Countdown to Kick-off
angles.copy: Just weeks to go until the Premier League returns! Arsenal will host Coventry City on opening night, August 21st. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Community Shield Build-up
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser, the Community Shield, is just around the corner on August 16th! Manchester City face Arsenal in Cardiff. Get ready for some silverware!

moments.title: Luke Combs at Wembley
moments.blurb: Country superstar Luke Combs is set for three massive shows at London's Wembley Stadium this weekend, starting July 31st.

angles.name: Country Takes Wembley
angles.copy: Luke Combs is bringing his 'My Kinda Saturday Night Tour' to Wembley Stadium for three huge nights, kicking off Friday! Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: It's a big weekend for country music fans in London! Luke Combs plays Wembley Fri, Sat & Sun. Get ready for a singalong!

moments.title: Cambridge Folk Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The renowned Cambridge Folk Festival runs from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring a diverse lineup of folk and roots artists.

angles.name: Folk Fest Fun
angles.copy: Cambridge Folk Festival opens its gates on Thursday! Four days of incredible music and atmosphere. Who are you excited to see?

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival
moments.blurb: Scotland's Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival takes place from July 30th to August 1st, bringing music and arts to the Highlands.

angles.name: Highland Hoolie
angles.copy: The 'Bella' is back! Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival kicks off Thursday in the Highlands. Get ready for a weekend of Scottish music and magic!

moments.title: Camp Bestival Shropshire
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival Shropshire, known for its family-friendly atmosphere and diverse music, runs from July 30th to August 2nd.

angles.name: Family Festival Fun
angles.copy: Camp Bestival Shropshire is almost here! From Thursday, it's four days of music, arts, and family fun. Who's packing their wellies?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Geddy Lee
moments.blurb: Rush bassist and vocalist Geddy Lee celebrates his 73rd birthday tomorrow, July 29th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're wishing a very Happy 73rd Birthday to the legendary Geddy Lee of Rush! What's your favourite Rush track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Kate Bush
moments.blurb: The iconic and influential singer-songwriter Kate Bush turns 68 on July 30th.

angles.name: Wuthering Heights Legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Kate Bush on Thursday! Her music still captivates generations. What's your go-to Kate Bush song?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Paul Anka
moments.blurb: Veteran singer, songwriter, and actor Paul Anka celebrates his 85th birthday on July 30th.

angles.name: Legendary Crooner
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Paul Anka this Thursday! 'Diana' and so many more classics. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Elliott
moments.blurb: Def Leppard frontman Joe Elliott will turn 67 on August 1st.

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Pour some sugar on him! We're celebrating Joe Elliott of Def Leppard's 67th birthday this Saturday! What's your ultimate Def Leppard anthem?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Butch Vig
moments.blurb: Garbage drummer and acclaimed producer Butch Vig celebrates his 71st birthday on August 2nd.

angles.name: Behind the Hits
angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 71st Birthday to the legendary Butch Vig this Sunday! Drummer for Garbage and producer of some of the biggest albums of the 90s. What's your favourite work of his?

moments.title: Happy Birthday James Hetfield
moments.blurb: Metallica's iconic frontman James Hetfield turns 63 on August 3rd.

angles.name: Metal God
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the mighty James Hetfield of Metallica on Monday! From 'Master of Puppets' to 'Enter Sandman', what's your top Metallica track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Geri Halliwell
moments.blurb: Spice Girls star Geri Halliwell-Horner (Ginger Spice) celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th.

angles.name: Spice Up Your Life
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell, this Thursday! What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Dickinson
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's legendary vocalist Bruce Dickinson turns 68 on August 7th.

angles.name: Air Raid Siren
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Happy 68th Birthday to the iconic Bruce Dickinson of Iron Maiden next Friday! What's your favourite Maiden track?

moments.title: July's Full Buck Moon
moments.blurb: The July Full Moon, traditionally known as the Buck Moon, reaches its peak illumination on Wednesday, July 29th.

angles.name: Look Up Tonight
angles.copy: Keep an eye on the sky! The July Full Moon, also known as the Buck Moon, reaches its peak tomorrow. A perfect summer night for stargazing!
